messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Yes—I can help, but first I need to authenticate your account.

Please tell me **the email address** on your order (or, if you don’t remember it, tell me your **first name + last name + ZIP code**).

Once I locate your account, I can:
- look up the order(s) shipped to **Texas** and get the **tracking number**
- set up a **return of everything except the pet bed** (this will require your **confirmation** and the **payment method** to receive the refund)

What’s the **email** (or name + ZIP)?
I actually don’t remember the email I used, but my name is Isabella Johansson and my ZIP code is 32286.
